brain.commentary: Risk-on regime is outweighed by weak or flat core-asset signals, elevated downside risk in ETH/SOL/LTC, and moderate institutional advisory risk. The identical long verdicts for XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are highly fragile: zero volatility, zero expected shortfall, and identical conviction/composite values strongly suggest missing or stale inputs rather than genuine conviction. Maintain a defensive overlay and avoid treating those signals as validated longs.
